name: Eventide H90 Harmonizer
firmware: H90 1.12.5 (2025-12-18) and its manual v1.12.5; no newer release found on 2026-11-05

midiIn.connector: 5-pin DIN in, DIN out/thru, USB-C (MIDI over USB); the TRS jacks are EXP/CTL only
midiIn.note: Standard DIN cable from the Thru5 WC.

clock.syncs: the tempo (delays, modulation rates): Tempo Menu > Tempo Source = MIDI Clock
clock.setting: Tempo Menu (hold Presets + Parameters) > Tempo Source = MIDI Clock; System > MIDI > Clock Source = DIN or USB

channelSetting: System Menu (hold Programs + Routing) > MIDI > Channel = 15 (receive and transmit) or Receive Omni.

channel.note: One channel for receive and transmit, or Receive Omni (System > MIDI). The default value is not stated in the manual; 15 is this rig's setting.

programChange.note: PC selects a Program in the current Playlist (a User List of up to 99). With PC Offset 0 (default) PC n loads Program n as displayed (1-based; PC 0 is not used); with PC Offset 1, PC 0 loads Program 1: set this definition's displayBase to 0 then. No bank select; banks of three are reached only by Bank Up / Down CC functions.

controllers.name: No default CC map: assign CC numbers per function in System > MIDI > Global Control (Load, Increment, Decrement, Bank Up/Down, Tuner, Tap Tempo, P/A/B active-bypass toggle or momentary, Insert 1/2, HotSwitch 1-3, Perform 1-6, Quick Knobs 1-6, HotKnob, In/Out gain, Mix) and enter them in the rig profile

setup: System > MIDI: PC Offset 0 keeps PC n = Program n as displayed; if you use PC Offset 1, set displayBase 0 in the rig.
Make the User List you play from the Playlist: program numbers in the song refer to its order.
Assign CC numbers for bypass / HotSwitch / tap in Global Control and enter them in the rig profile.
Tempo Menu > Tempo Source = MIDI Clock and System > MIDI > Clock Source = DIN, so delays follow Classic Tabby's clock.
A CC sent right after a PC is ignored on 1.9.x (Eventide staff, March 2025: 'not addressed'; no later release note says fixed, 1.12.5 included): keep this device's gap after the program change.
notes: Program names are per user (the Playlist is user-arranged): name the 99 slots in the rig profile.
A PC loads the whole Program (both A and B); presets A/B are not selectable by MIDI.
